modal.title: Tell us how Kaydo is doing
modal.subtitle: Something broken, something missing, something you love — it all helps. This goes to the people who build Kaydo, not to your family.

rating.label: How is the app treating you?
rating.hint: Optional — tap a star again to take it back.

message.label: Your feedback
message.placeholder: What happened, what you expected, or what you wish the app could do…

contact.label: Email for a reply
contact.hint: Optional. Only used to answer you — leave it empty to stay anonymous.

privacyNote: Unlike your memories, feedback is not encrypted — it has to be readable for anyone to act on it. Your language, the page you were on and your browser version are sent along. Please leave private family details out.

sent.title: Thank you
sent.body: Your feedback has arrived. Every note is read by a person.

errors.messageRequired: Please write a few words before sending.
errors.messageTooLong: That is longer than the form can take — please shorten it a little.
errors.contactTooLong: That email address is too long.
errors.sendFailed: Your feedback could not be sent. Please check your connection and try again.
